interactions.note: The epitope-specific LEM-2/15 Fab inhibited the enzymatic activity of the catalytic domain of MT1-MMP using a 6-mer fluorogenic substrate, rat collagen type I or gelatin as substrate. Inhibition was noncompetitive. Fab LEM-2/15 binds to the V-B loop located away from the active site and does not sterically inhibit binding of the small molecule substrate. Analysis by x-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) showed no changes in spectral features or in the structural parameters of the catalytic zinc histidine-nearest environment upon binding of Fab LEM-2/15 to CAT-MT1-MMP, supporting the observed noncompetitive mode of inhibition by Fab LEM-2/15. In separate assays, Fab LEM-2/15 was shown to inhibit the collagenase activity of MT1-MMP expressed on the cell surface and did not interfere with activation of proMMP-2 or enzyme dimerization.
